title: Seminar in Performance of New Music
description: This seminar/workshop provides intensive professional training for performers who work together with composers in the creation, performance, and production of new music. Graduate performers prepare new works composed specifically for them by the composers registered simultaneously in 562B. Training in contemporary notation and performance practices, extended techniques, instrumentation, analysis, conducting techniques, communication skills, and concert production. The final project is a festival.
notes: A combined undergraduate and graduate course (MUS 462B Undergraduate Seminar in Contemporary Composition and Performance).
